description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy class, verifying its behavior for scenarios where placeholders are present or absent in policy creation commands.

classes.name: CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy, extending AbstractSubstitutionStrategyTestBase, testing substitution behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the apply method returns the same command object when no placeholders are present in the policy.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the apply method returns a command with substituted placeholders when placeholders are present in the policy.
